sections.title: Right now
lines: Pre-race growth, green flag Wed 11:00pm CT. Sold 40,820, 66,175 resting. Worst line -$1,065. Bot is slow (checks every 2m, set for 30s).

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A driver gets a new wave when 90% of what he offered has sold.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It stops a driver whose line falls under -$1,000.
Glide starts Wed 7:00pm CT: limit slides from -$1,000 to $0 by Wed 11:00pm CT.
Under the limit it trims rows, buys back cheaply, and sells to close gaps from Wed 9:30pm CT.
Even-up from Wed 10:00pm CT, last-resort take from Wed 10:40pm CT, green flag Wed 11:00pm CT.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: waves, price steps and the glide run by rule. The worst line may not fully close.
